_comment: Manual camera-clock corrections for the one-off database repair.
On 2026-01-06..08 the Civic camera's own clock was running about five hours
slow. Five drives from those days carry enough satellite fixes to measure the
error directly (listed under measured_from), and the repair takes their GPS
time as the truth. The drives listed under tags are from the same window but
have too few usable fixes to measure anything, so without this file the repair
would fall back to the very clock that was wrong and place them five hours
early. Their corrected start is the clip filename time plus offset_s, and they
are recorded as time_confidence = filename_estimated_clock_offset so it stays
visible that the time was inferred rather than measured.
Approved by the owner on 2026-09-15 after reviewing the repair report.

offset_measured.method: median of (GPS median anchor - filename time) over the drives below
